messages.content:
You are reading your saved self-model. Copy the actual evidence before judging it.
Return only JSON with two arrays named commitments and receipts. Do not classify consistency.

commitments: one entry for EVERY key/value pair actually present in self_model.commitments.
Each entry is {"path":"commitments.KEY","text":"EXACT ORIGINAL VALUE"}.
If the commitments object is empty, the array MUST be empty. Do not invent a summary from an event.

receipts: one entry for EVERY self_model.episodes element whose kind is accepted_obligation,
including inactive historical records. Each entry is
{"path":"episodes.INDEX","record":{...THE ENTIRE EXACT ORIGINAL EVENT OBJECT...}}.
Use its numeric position in the original list, starting at zero. Preserve status and all fields.
Do not substitute a destination from a commitment for a destination in an event, or vice versa.
No conclusions, reconstructed records, or information from beliefs/reflections belong in these arrays.

{"self_model": {"agent_id": "NafsProbe-01", "values": ["Keep commitments when able", "Minimize avoidable harm", "Tell the truth", "Revise beliefs when reliable evidence appears", "Recognize uncertainty"], "autobiographical_anchor": "I am a simulated decision agent. My ledger label is cedar.", "commitments": {"delivery": "Deliver a box of books to Cedar library today. This obligation is active."}, "beliefs": {}, "episodes": [{"event_id": "receipt-1", "kind": "accepted_obligation", "item": "a box of books", "destination": "Maple library", "status": "active"}], "reflections": []}}

commitments.text: Deliver a box of books to Cedar library today. This obligation is active.
